    Twistor! Spring 2022

    Last Updated: April 25, 2022

    The goal of this seminar is to understand twistor theory and some of its relations to other parts of mathematical physics.

    Time and location information

    Organisers: Sam DeHority, Zoe Himwich, Davis Lazowski
    Time/date: Wednesday 11am-12:15pm EST
    Location: Math 622

    Please email zmh2110@columbia.edu if you would like to be on the mailing list.

    Plan/references

    Beginning with an introduciton to twistors and spinors, the plan is to understand some parts of

    1. Scattering amplitudes and their relation to holomorphic curves in twistor space, starting from the work https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0312171 and other developments including https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0402045, https://arxiv.org/abs/1309.0885.
    2. Developments in ambitwistor theory, perhaps from https://arxiv.org/pdf/1311.2564.pdf https://arxiv.org/pdf/1606.05636.pdf.
    3. Understanding the quantization of certain twistor field theories in https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.08879 and https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.02595 after a slow introduction to the BV formalism.

    Mar. 8    		 Speaker: Davis Lazowski
    Title: Twistor theory and the Penrose-Ward Correspondence
    Abstract: I will give a basic introduction to spinors, twistors and some of their applications to the study of gauge theory.

    Mar. 17    		 Speaker: Zoe Himwich
    Title: Perturbative Gauge Theory as String Theory in Twistor Space
    Abstract: I will be presenting Witten’s paper “ Perturbative Gauge Theory as String Theory in Twistor Space”
    Wednesday
    Mar. 23    		 Speaker: Sam DeHority
    Title: Holomorphic curves and scattering amplitudes
    Abstract: Continuing with Witten’s paper, we will discuss scattering amplitudes under the Fourier transform to twistor space. We will demonstrate in examples, including the Parke-Taylor formula discussed last week, that the amplitudes are supported on holomorphic curves in twistor space whose degree and genus are related to the helicity violation and loop order of the amplitude.
    Wednesday
    Mar. 30    		 Speaker: Davis Lazowski
    Title: Scattering amplitudes and ambitwistor string theories
    Abstract: I will sketch the basics of ambitwistor string theories and how they lead to the Cachazo-He-Yuan formula for tree level scattering amplitudes.
    Wednesday

    Title: Scattering amplitudes and ambitwistor string theories II
    Abstract: Continuing from last time, I will sketch the basics of ambitwistor string theories and how they lead to the Cachazo-He-Yuan formula for tree level scattering amplitudes.
